description: This Java source file defines the 'ThingQueryCommandAdapter' class, which functions as an adapter for mapping 'ThingQueryCommand' objects to and from 'Adaptable' entities within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter framework. It includes methods for creating new adapter instances, determining the type based on topic path, and mapping signals to adaptables, specifically handling 'RetrieveThings' commands.

classes.name: ThingQueryCommandAdapter
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractThingAdapter to convert between ThingQueryCommand objects and Adaptable instances, supporting specific command types like RetrieveThings.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate a new 'ThingQueryCommandAdapter' with a given HeaderTranslator.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Determines the type of command based on the Adaptable's TopicPath, returning a specific type for wildcard topics.

methods.name: mapSignalToAdaptable
methods.description: Maps a 'ThingQueryCommand' signal to an 'Adaptable' object, specialized for 'RetrieveThings' commands.
